ciudades.description: The Great Wall of China is a series of fortifications that were built across the historical northern borders of ancient Chinese states. It is the longest structure humans have ever built. It is about 21,196 kilometers long, 9.1 metres (30 feet) wide and 15 metres high.

The Great Pyramid of Giza (also known as the Pyramid of Khufu or the Pyramid of Cheops) is the oldest and largest of the pyramids in the Giza pyramid complex bordering present-day Giza in Greater Cairo, Egypt. It is the oldest of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World, and the only one to remain largely intact.
The Grand Palace is a complex of buildings at the heart of Bangkok, Thailand. The palace has been the official residence of the Kings of Siam (and later Thailand) since 1782.

Rising to 12,388 feet (3,776 metres), Mount Fuji is the tallest mountain in Japan and is known for its graceful conical form. It is the country's sacred symbol, and temples and shrines are located around and on the volcano.
Neuschwanstein Castle, German Schloss Neuschwanstein, elaborate castle near Füssen, Germany, built atop a rock ledge over the Pöllat Gorge in the Bavarian Alps by order of Bavaria's King Louis II.

The Colosseum is an amphitheatre built in Rome under the Flavian emperors of the Roman Empire. It is also called the Flavian Amphitheatre. It is an elliptical structure made of stone, concrete, and tuff.
Chichén Itzá, ruined ancient Maya city occupying an area of 4 square miles (10 square km) in south-central Yucatán state, Mexico.

Hagia Sophia, an important Byzantine structure in Istanbul and one of the world's great monuments. It was built as a Christian church in the 6th century CE under the direction of the Byzantine emperor Justinian I.

Originally built in 1395, Gyeongbokgung Palace is the largest and greatest of Seoul's Five Grand Palaces. Today, the palace grounds, filled with lotus ponds, gardens, and ornate statues, offer a lovely place to spend the afternoon.
This famous Buddhist temple, dating from the 8th and 9th centuries, is located in central Java. Around the circular platforms are 72 openwork stupas, each containing a statue of the Buddha.
Mount Kilimanjaro is the tallest mountain on the African continent and the highest free-standing mountain in the world. Kilimanjaro has three volcanic cones, Mawenzi, Shira and Kibo.
Iguaçu Falls, series of cataracts on the Iguaçu River, 14 miles above its confluence with the Alto Paraná River, at the Argentina-Brazil border.
Machu Picchu, Ancient fortress city of the Incas in the Andes Mountains, south-central Peru. Perched near Cuzco in a narrow saddle between two sharp peaks, at an elevation of 7,710 ft.

The Acropolis of Athens is one of the most famous ancient archaeological sites in the world. Located on a limestone hill high above Athens, Greece, the Acropolis has been inhabited since prehistoric times.
An immense mausoleum of white marble, built in Agra between 1631 and 1648 by order of the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan in memory of his favourite wife.

itinerarios.name: Great Wall of China
itinerarios.details: Few cities in the world have served for so long as the political headquarters and cultural centre of an area as immense as China.

itinerarios.name: Yonghe Temple & Imperial Beijing

itinerarios.name: Pyramid of Khafre
itinerarios.details: Built by Khufu's son Khafre, it at first appears to be larger than his father's earlier pyramid as it stands on a higher piece of land.

itinerarios.name: Solar Boat Museum
itinerarios.details: Excavations on the south and east sides of the Pyramid of Cheops in 1954 brought to light five long cavities for boats, with a Solar Barque broken into more than a thousand pieces as a votive offering.

activities.name: Hike on the Great Wall at Night
activities.description: You may have seen beautiful pictures of the Great Wall below blue sky and white clouds. But have you seen Great Wall glowing at night?

activities.name: Take a Roller Coaster Cart Down from the Great Wall
activities.description: The Great Wall was built on mountain ridges. So, to reach the wall, you will usually need to hike up mountain paths for about 1 hour, and you will also need to hike down.

activities.name: The Huangyaguan Great Wall Marathon
activities.description: The Huangyaguan Marathon was first held in 1999, and has become very popular for its challenging route, stunning Great Wall scenery, and quiet Chinese villages.

activities.name: Forbidden City
activities.description: This once restricted imperial palace is today a public museum showcasing the splendor of ancient China. It is one of the most impressive places in Beijing.

activities.name: Tiananmen Square
activities.description: This place is one of the most famous squares in the world and the very heart of Beijing.

activities.name: Heaven Temple
activities.description: Behind a high wall is an ancient building once used for sacrifices. This huge, historic place of worship is a tranquil oasis in the middle of Beijing.

activities.name: Chureito Pagoda Viewpoint

activities.name: Lake Kawaguchiko Shore Walk
activities.description: Tranquil reflections of the snow-capped peak across serene mirror-like waters.

activities.name: Oshino Hakkai Sacred Springs
activities.description: Eight crystal-clear ponds fed by melted snow filtered through Mount Fuji's volcanic rock.

activities.name: Garganta del Diablo (Devil's Throat)

activities.name: Upper Circuit Catwalks
activities.description: Suspended walkways crossing cascading streams right over the edge of the falls.

activities.name: Macuco Jungle Boat Experience
activities.description: Power directly under the refreshing cascades inside the Atlantic rainforest.

activities.name: Hagia Sophia Grand Mosque
activities.description: Sixth-century Byzantine dome with celestial golden mosaics and soaring minarets.

activities.name: Blue Mosque (Sultan Ahmed)
activities.description: Cascading domes lined with tens of thousands of handmade Iznik blue tiles.

activities.name: Grand Bazaar Spice Discovery
activities.description: Wander through 4,000 historic vaulted stalls rich in saffron, lamps, and Turkish delight.

activities.name: Borobudur Temple Stupas
activities.description: World's largest Buddhist temple crowned with seventy-two perforated bell stupas.

activities.name: Prambanan Hindu Sanctuary
activities.description: Towering ninth-century spires honoring Shiva, Brahma, and Vishnu.

activities.name: Mount Bromo Sea of Sand

activities.name: Marangu Gate Rain Forest Trek
activities.description: Encounter blue monkeys and exotic orchids along the lush lower slopes.

activities.name: Mandara Hut Moorland Ridge
activities.description: Ascend above the cloud line to volcanic heather fields and panoramic viewpoints.

activities.name: Moshi Coffee Plantation Walk
activities.description: Sample fresh Arabica coffee harvested on rich volcanic mountain soil.

activities.name: Intihuatana Sacred Sun Stone
activities.description: Carved granite sundial and astronomic shrine of the Incan high priests.

activities.name: Sun Gate (Inti Punku) Panorama
activities.description: First dramatic viewpoint of the lost citadel shrouded in morning mountain mist.

activities.name: Terraced Agricultural Enclaves
activities.description: Verdant stone terraces where llamas graze above the rushing Urubamba River.

activities.name: Marienbrücke (Mary's Bridge)
activities.description: The ultimate vantage point suspended above the Pöllat Gorge overlooking Neuschwanstein.

activities.name: King Ludwig II Throne Room
activities.description: Intricate Byzantine-inspired gold mosaics and dramatic gothic halls inside the castle.

activities.name: Alpsee Lake Promenade
activities.description: Crystal alpine waters nestled at the foot of Hohenschwangau Castle and towering pines.

activities.name: Colosseum Gladiators Arena
activities.description: Walk in the footsteps of ancient gladiators inside Rome's legendary amphitheater.

activities.name: Roman Forum & Palatine Hill
activities.description: Explore the epic ruins of temples, triumphal arches, and imperial palaces.

activities.name: Trevi Fountain Coin Toss
activities.description: Baroque masterpiece in marble where tossing a coin guarantees your return to Rome.

activities.name: Gyeongbokgung Royal Palace
activities.description: Watch the changing of the royal guard in traditional colorful Joseon robes.

activities.name: Bukchon Hanok Traditional Village
activities.description: Preserved tile-roofed wooden alleys dating back 600 years overlooking Seoul's skyline.

activities.name: N Seoul Tower & Namsan Sunset
activities.description: Panoramic observatory with breathtaking views across the Han River.

activities.name: Taj Mahal Reflecting Pools
activities.description: Pure white marble mausoleum reflecting in the Charbagh Persian water gardens at dawn.

activities.name: Agra Red Fort Palaces
activities.description: Massive red sandstone fortress where Mughal emperors governed and beheld the Taj Mahal.

activities.name: Mehtab Bagh Moonlight Garden
activities.description: Tranquil riverside park across the Yamuna offering the best sunset silhouette of the dome.
